messages:
hana: Heads-up: rolling out the new Stream Gateway to GA right now. This unifies streaming + tool calls into one lightweight endpoint: POST /v1/stream-gateway. Docs + short migration notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga.

ryan: Nice. Will SDKs need changes?

hana: Minimal. Well ship small SDK patches that default streaming clients to the gateway once auto-migration starts. Existing behavior continues for 14 days via an opt-in toggle in Console.

ryan: Any new models bundled with this?

hana: Yes 1 were offering mosaic-lite-4q (4-bit quantized) tuned for low cold-starts and high concurrency. Its lower memory but slightly different output distribution. We included fallback routing to mosaic-pro if quality checks fail.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Stream-gateway service deployed to us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-central-1. Canary at 25% -> 75%. No fatal errors. Logs: https://internal-logs/stream-gateway/1842004321

olivia: Any billing changes?

hana: Billing remains token-based. Console will show an estimated per-route cost delta when you switch to the gateway.

ryan: Paste a curl example?

hana: Sure:
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-gateway \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite-4q","stream":true,"tools":true,"input":"generate a JSON summary"}'
```

olivia: Noted a small doc typo under migration steps. Filed a PR to fix.

hana: Thanks. TL;DR: Stream Gateway GA live, mosaic-lite-4q available, 14-day opt-in for existing orgs then auto-migration windows start. DM me or @ryan for canary keys. :tada:
